SELECT CAST(rsd.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryId, DATE_FORMAT(rsd.biz_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(rsd.availability_count) AS inventory, SUM(rsd.availability_count) AS inv, SUM(rsd.availability_count) AS remain, SUM(rsd.availability_count) AS remainNum, SUM(rsd.availability_count) AS availableNum, SUM(rsd.availability_count) AS num FROM room_status_daily rsd
GROUP BY rsd.room_category_id, rsd.biz_date ORDER BY rsd.room_category_id ASC, rsd.biz_date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(rsd.biz_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, CONCAT('余', SUM(rsd.availability_count), '间') AS remain, SUM(rsd.availability_count) AS remainNum, SUM(rsd.availability_count) AS availableNum, SUM(rsd.availability_count) AS num FROM room_status_daily rsd
GROUP BY rsd.biz_date ORDER BY rsd.biz_date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(rsd.biz_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(rsd.availability_count) AS availabilityCount, SUM(rsd.open_room_count) AS openRoomCount, SUM(rsd.room_sale_count) AS roomSaleCount, SUM(rsd.vacant_count) AS vacantCount, CASE WHEN SUM(rsd.availability_count) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(rsd.open_room_count) / SUM(rsd.availability_count), 4) END AS occ, CASE WHEN SUM(rsd.availability_count) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(rsd.open_room_count) / SUM(rsd.availability_count), 4) END AS occupancyRate FROM room_status_daily rsd
GROUP BY rsd.biz_date ORDER BY rsd.biz_date ASC

SELECT CAST(om.room_category_id AS CHAR) AS roomCategoryId, CAST(om.room_id AS CHAR) AS roomId, DATE_FORMAT(om.start_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, om.guest_name AS guestName, ca.channel_name AS channelName, ROUND(om.total_price_cent / 100, 2) AS roomFee, ROUND(om.total_pay_price_cent / 100, 2) AS totalIncome, CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(om.start_at, '%Y-%m-%d'), '-', DATE_FORMAT(om.end_at, '%m-%d')) AS stayRange, om.guest_mobile AS phone, om.remark AS remark, CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) AS orderId, CAST(om.order_id AS CHAR) AS id, CASE WHEN om.remark IS NULL OR om.remark = '' THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS hasRemark, CASE WHEN om.status = 'checked_in' THEN '入住中' WHEN om.status IN ('booked', 'pending') THEN '待入住' WHEN om.status IN ('checked_out', 'completed') THEN '已退房' ELSE om.status END AS liveStatusName, CASE WHEN om.status = 'checked_in' THEN '入住中' WHEN om.status IN ('booked', 'pending') THEN '待入住' WHEN om.status IN ('checked_out', 'completed') THEN '已退房' ELSE om.status END AS statusName, DATE_FORMAT(om.start_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS checkInDate, DATE_FORMAT(om.end_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS checkOutDate FROM order_main om LEFT JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = om.channel_id AND ca.camp_id = om.camp_id
ORDER BY om.start_at ASC, om.order_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
